mapper.sql: ut.id, ut.task_id, t.title, t.description, t.reward_type, t.reward_value, ut.status AS task_status, ut.created_at AS joined_at, ut.completed_at, ut.reward_issued, st.name AS store_name, CASE WHEN t.status != 'ACTIVE' THEN t.status WHEN NOW() < t.start_at THEN 'PENDING' WHEN NOW() > t.end_at THEN 'ENDED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS task_effective_status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_task ut JOIN task t ON ut.task_id = t.id LEFT JOIN store st ON t.store_id = st.id WHERE ut.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY ut.created_at DESC, ut.id DESC LIMIT #{page.offset}, #{page.size}

SELECT ut.id, ut.task_id, t.title, t.description, t.reward_type, t.reward_value, ut.status AS task_status, ut.created_at AS joined_at, ut.completed_at, ut.reward_issued, ut.task_code, st.name AS store_name, CASE WHEN t.status != 'ACTIVE' THEN t.status WHEN NOW() < t.start_at THEN 'PENDING' WHEN NOW() > t.end_at THEN 'ENDED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS task_effective_status FROM user_task ut JOIN task t ON ut.task_id = t.id LEFT JOIN store st ON t.store_id = st.id WHERE ut.user_id=#{userId} AND ut.id=#{userTaskId}
